fam_onboard_title: Keep your people close at the Kumbh
fam_onboard_body: One place for who you're travelling with, who looks after whom, and who to call first.
fam_how_1_body: Name your family. You become its organizer.
fam_how_2_body: Children and elders who won't use the app don't need an account.
fam_how_3_body: They see what joining means and choose for themselves.
fam_private_body: Your phone number and contacts stay yours until you choose to share them. This doesn't track or share anyone's location.
fam_add_who: Who would you like to add?
fam_add_dependent_hint: A child or elder with no account of their own
fam_add_adult_hint: They have the app and decide for themselves
fam_offer_body: You've been offered this role, or it's vacant. It only moves to you if you accept.
fam_tip_1_body: Each day, pick one easy-to-find spot and a time. If anyone gets separated, everyone knows where to go.
fam_tip_2_title: Carry a number on every child
fam_tip_2_body: Put a guardian's phone number in a child's pocket or on a wristband. Teach them to show it to the police or a volunteer.
fam_tip_3_body: A photo of what everyone is wearing today helps others to find them quickly.
fam_tip_4_body: Hold hands in dense crowds, keep elders in the middle of your group, and don't stop in narrow passages.
fam_scope_note: This is general advice, not official instructions. Always follow the police and event staff.
fam_contact_retry: Your family was created, but the contact wasn't saved. Please add it again.
fam_create_name_title: What should we call your family?
fam_create_name_hint: Everyone who joins will see this name.
fam_role_can_1: You add and look after those in your care.
fam_role_can_2: You invite adults and keep the family's emergency contacts.
fam_role_cannot: You can't see or change another adult's private details. They stay with them.
fam_create_contact_hint: Ideally someone who isn't travelling with you. You can add this later.
fam_create_no_messages: Nobody is messaged when you do this. You decide who to invite next.
fam_photo_failed: Saved, but the photo couldn't be uploaded.
fam_photo_optional: Photo (optional). Only your family can see it.
fam_add_birth: Or add a date of birth
fam_age_required: Choose an age group or add a date of birth.
fam_consent_agreed: They have agreed to being added
fam_consent_authority: I have the authority to act for them

fam_dep_who_hint: They won't need an account. You'll be their guardian.
fam_dep_details_hint: Only what helps someone look after them.
fam_invite_consent: Adults join only if they accept. Nobody is added without agreeing.
fam_invite_phone_hint: If they use this number on Kumbh Path, the invitation waits in their app. Only they can use it.
fam_invite_will_see_body: The family's name, your name, how many are in it, and what joining shares. Nothing else.
fam_code_in_app: We don't send this anywhere. It's waiting in their app if they use that number, and you can also share the code yourself. It works once.
fam_code_not_sent: We haven't sent this to anyone. Share it yourself with the person you're inviting. It works once, and won't be shown again.
fam_code_invalid: This code isn't valid. It may have expired, been used or been revoked.
fam_join_hint: You'll see the family and what's shared before you decide.
fam_review_can_title: If you join, the family can see
fam_review_can_body: Your name, your photo if you add one, and that you're part of the family.
fam_review_cannot_body: Your phone number or emergency contacts, unless you choose to share them. Your location. Nobody, including the organizer, can act as you or edit your details.
fam_review_leave: You can leave at any time.
fam_remove_body: They'll no longer be part of this family, and their emergency contacts here will be removed.
fam_no_more_guardians: There's no other adult to add yet.
fam_dependent_note: In the family's care. Their guardians and the organizer manage these details.
fam_self_note: This is you. Only you can change your details.
fam_adult_note: {} manages their own details and chooses what to share.
fam_privacy_body: Everything here starts off. Turn something on only if you want to.
fam_share_phone: Share my number with the family
fam_share_phone_hint: Members can see and call it.
fam_share_contacts: Show my emergency contacts to the organizer
fam_share_contacts_hint: They can read them, but can't change them.
fam_contact_delete_body: They'll be removed from this list.
fam_no_contacts_body: Add people in the order they should be tried.
fam_contacts_private: Private to this family. Nothing is sent to these people automatically.
fam_handover_hint: The other adult has to accept before anything changes.
fam_handover_body: You stay organizer until they accept.
fam_handover_sent: Offered to {}. They'll see it in Family Safety.
fam_delete_body: This removes the family, its dependents' details and its contacts. It can't be undone. Other adults need to leave first.
fam_leave_hint: You can leave whenever you like. Your emergency contacts here are removed with you.
fam_leave_body: You'll need a new invitation to come back. Anyone you were the only guardian for moves to the organizer.
fam_offline_saved_body: Emergency contacts are saved securely on this phone, so you can still see and call them.
fam_sync_offline: Offline. Showing contacts saved on this phone.
fam_sync_retrying: Couldn't sync. We'll try again automatically.
fam_sync_signed_out: Sign in again to sync your changes. They're safe on this phone.
fam_saved_offline: Saved on this phone. It will sync when you're back online.
fam_row_failed: The server couldn't accept this change.
fam_row_conflict: Someone else changed this contact to:
fam_row_conflict_delete: You deleted this, but someone else changed it to:
fam_no_saved_contacts_title: Not saved on this phone yet
fam_no_saved_contacts_body: Connect to the internet once to save these contacts for offline use.
fam_link_invalid_body: Check you opened the whole link, or ask for a new one. It may also be meant for a different phone number.
fam_link_expired_body: Invitations last 3 days. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
fam_link_revoked_body: The family organizer has cancelled it. Ask them if you need a new one.
fam_link_accepted_body: Each invitation works once. Ask for a new one if you still need to join.
fam_link_declined_body: Ask the person who sent it for a new one if you've changed your mind.
fam_share_note: Nothing is sent until you press send. Share it only with the person you're inviting: it works once, and expires on {}.

fam_share_opened_sms: Messages opened. Press send to share your invitation.
fam_share_cancelled: Sharing cancelled. Your invitation is still open.

fam_sms_missing: Messages isn't available on this phone. Choose another app.

fam_share_failed: Couldn't share this. Please try again.
qr_status_revoked: Revoked. The old card no longer works.
qr_none_body: If you're separated in the crowd, a registered helper can scan it and tell your family.
qr_how_1_body: Print it for a pocket or lanyard, or keep it on your phone.
qr_how_2_title: Only registered helpers can read it
qr_how_2_body: The code has no name or number in it. An ordinary camera learns nothing about you.
qr_how_3_body: The helper confirms what's happening, and your family gets an alert in the app. They never see your family's numbers.
qr_private_body: A random code and one initial. No name, phone number or family details, so it's safe to wear in a crowd.
qr_card_failed: Couldn't prepare the card. Please try again.
qr_regenerate_body: Printed and saved copies of the old card will stop working straight away. Print a new one.
qr_revoke_body: Helpers won't be able to read this card, for example if it's lost.
qr_offline_none: This card isn't saved on this phone yet. Connect to the internet once to see it.
qr_offline_saved: Showing the copy saved on this phone. It may have been replaced since.
qr_share_location: Let my family see where a helper found me
qr_share_location_hint: Only if a registered helper reports you and records their location. This app doesn't track you.
scan_hint: Point the camera at a Kumbh Path safety card.
scan_not_ours: This isn't a Kumbh Path safety card.
scan_unknown: This code isn't recognised. Keep the person safe and take them to a help desk.
scan_revoked: This card has been turned off. Keep the person safe and take them to a help desk.
scan_expired: That scan timed out. Please scan the card again.
scan_not_helper_body: If you've found someone with a safety card, stay with them and take them to the nearest police post or help desk.
scan_camera_denied_body: Allow the camera in Settings to scan safety cards.
scan_camera_failed_body: Close other camera apps and try again.
scan_verify_title: A card is not an identity
scan_verify_body: The card may not belong to the person holding it. Check with them before you report anything.
scan_verify_child: The card may not belong to this child. Stay with them, and never hand a child to anyone because of a scan.
scan_sit_separated_hint: They're with you and need to reach their family
scan_sit_medical_hint: Call medical staff first. This only tells the family.
scan_sit_other_hint: Anything else they need help with
scan_sit_suspicious_hint: Recorded for review. The family isn't told.
scan_note: Where can the family find them? (optional)
scan_note_hint: For example, the help desk you're at. No personal details.
scan_share_location_hint: Only your location, once, if you allow it.
scan_confirm_title: Have you checked this in person?
scan_confirm_alert: This sends an alert to the family. It doesn't mark anyone as missing.
scan_confirm_flag: This records the scan for review. The family isn't told.
scan_delivered: The alert was sent to the family's phones. It may not have been seen yet.
scan_no_devices: Saved, but no one in this family has a phone that can receive alerts. Take the person to a help desk.
scan_undelivered: Saved, but the alert couldn't be sent right now. The family can see it in the app. Take the person to a help desk.
scan_duplicate: This has already been reported, so the family wasn't alerted again.
scan_handover_body: A QR scan doesn't prove who a guardian is. A person must verify the guardian in person, by following the help desk's rules.
scan_flagged_body: The family hasn't been told. If someone needs help, take them to a help desk.
alert_none_body: If a registered helper reports someone in your care, it will appear here.
alert_handover_family: Go to the place shown, and take identification. Helpers must verify you in person, and a QR scan doesn't prove who you are.
alert_reported_by_help_desk: Reported by a registered help desk
alert_location_withheld: A location was recorded, but this adult hasn't chosen to share it.
alert_resolve_body: This closes the alert for your family.
lf_home_body: Tell us who you're looking for. Your report stays private.
lf_now_1: Stay where you were last together, if it's safe.
lf_now_2: Tell the nearest police post or help desk straight away.
lf_now_3: If it's a child or someone at risk, call 112.
lf_not_official: Kumbh Path helps families and registered helpers coordinate. It isn't a police or government reporting system, so tell the police as well.
lf_private_note: Reports are never public. Only you, your family and authorized staff can see them.
lf_draft_body: Saved on this phone only. Tap to finish it.
lf_waiting_body: Waiting for a connection. Nobody has received this yet.
lf_draft_refused_body: It wasn't accepted. Tap to fix it.
lf_status_SUBMITTED_means: Your report has been received and is waiting for a person to look at it.
lf_status_UNDER_REVIEW_means: Safety staff are looking at this report.
lf_status_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED_means: Staff are checking some details. They may ask you for more.
lf_status_POTENTIAL_MATCH_FOUND_means: Staff are checking a possible lead. It isn't confirmed.
lf_status_MATCH_CONFIRMED_means: Staff have confirmed this in person. Follow the instructions below.
lf_status_REUNITED_means: Staff have recorded that this person is back with their family.
lf_status_REJECTED_means: Staff couldn't take this report forward. Please go to a help desk.
lf_who_hint: It's saved as you go, so you won't lose it if the signal drops.
lf_describe_hint: What they're wearing helps most in a crowd.
lf_photo_private: Only authorized staff and your family can see it. It's never public.
lf_seen_title: When and where were they last seen?
lf_field_place_hint: A ghat, gate, temple or landmark
lf_gps_note: Only if you allow it, once. Nobody is being tracked.
lf_gps_failed: Couldn't get your location. Describe the place instead.
lf_contact_private: Your number is only available to staff working on this case, and each use is recorded.
lf_need_relationship: Tell us how you know them.
lf_need_facility: Say which help desk the child is safe at.
lf_child_rules_body: Stay with them and take them to a help desk. Never send a child off alone, and never hand them to anyone without staff checking first.
lf_field_facility: Help desk or safe place they're at
lf_field_facility_hint: Families are told this, so keep it specific
lf_field_assistance: What help do they need now?
lf_done_body: Keep this reference. Authorized staff will review your report.
lf_done_waiting_body: You're offline, so nobody has received this. It will send by itself when you're connected. Please also tell a help desk now.
lf_next_body: You'll see updates here and get a notification. Keep going to the police or a help desk: don't wait for this app.
lf_handover_body: Go to the place shown and take identification. Staff must check you in person before anyone is released.
lf_description_source: As reported. Not checked by staff unless marked.
lf_not_live: This is a reported place, not live tracking.
lf_reported_helper: Reported by a helper, not verified
lf_cancel_body: Only cancel if you no longer need help finding them.
lf_confirm_body: This tells the safety team. They'll close the case once it's been checked.
lf_confirm_sent: You've told the team you're back together.
lf_sighting_hint: Staff review this before it appears on the case.
lf_ops_vulnerable_body: Keep their details and location among authorized staff. Release only after an in-person check.
lf_ops_family_says: The family says they're back together. Check before closing.
lf_ops_reveal_logged: Viewing this is recorded in the case history.
lf_ops_matches_note: Suggestions for you to review. Never proof of identity.
lf_match_warning_body: Similar descriptions don't prove who someone is. Only confirm after checking in person.
lf_match_notify: Tell the family staff are checking a lead
lf_match_notify_hint: They won't see the other report.
lf_check_hint: Record what a person actually checked. This stays in the case history.
lf_check_identity: I checked this person's identity in person
lf_check_recognised: The person recognised them and is willing to go

loc_offline_note: We can't reach the server, so this may be out of date.
loc_may_have_moved: They may have moved since then.

loc_empty_body: People appear here only when they choose to share with you.
loc_no_family_body: Location sharing works inside your Family Circle.
loc_no_positions_body: These people are sharing with you, but there's no position to show right now.
loc_mine_interrupted: Your location can't be read right now
loc_stop_body: Your family will no longer see your location, and it is deleted from the server.
loc_stopped_offline: Stopped on this phone. The server will be told when you're back online.
loc_my_expired: Your sharing time ended, so your location is no longer shared.
loc_my_stopped: Your location is no longer shared.
loc_start_intro: For a limited time, with only the people you choose. It's off until you turn it on.
loc_dependent_note: This uses this phone's location. Keep this phone with {}.
loc_no_one_eligible: There's no one else in your family to share with yet.
loc_until_stopped_note: It still ends by itself after {} hours.
loc_background_android: To keep your family updated when you leave the app, Android shows a notification for as long as you share. If you close the app fully, or the phone's battery saver stops it, updates stop until you open the app again.
loc_background_ios: To keep your family updated when you leave the app, iPhone shows a location indicator while you share. If you swipe the app away, updates stop until you open it again.
loc_consent: I agree to share my location with the people chosen above until I stop or the time ends.
loc_consent_dependent: I am responsible for {} and agree to share this phone's location with the people chosen above.
loc_need_consent: Tick the box to agree before you start.
loc_permission_needed: Sharing needs location access. See the note above.
loc_nothing_to_start: There's nothing else you can share right now.
loc_gps_off_body: Turn on your phone's location to share.
loc_blocked_body: Allow location for Kumbh Path in your phone's settings.
loc_ask_title: Your phone will ask for permission
loc_ask_body: Kumbh Path uses your location only for this sharing. Choose "While using the app" or better.
loc_approx_body: Your family will see a rough area, not your exact place. Allow precise location for better accuracy.
loc_notifications_body: Sharing can continue, but you may not see its notification. Allow notifications so you can always see that it's on.
loc_notification_text: Your chosen family members can see you. Open Kumbh Path to stop.
loc_status_on: The people below can see your location.
loc_status_paused: Paused. Nothing is being collected, and your position is hidden.
loc_status_interrupted: Sharing is on, but this phone can't give a position right now.
loc_sending_later: No connection. Your newest position will be sent when you're back online.
loc_other_phone: This sharing is running on another phone.
loc_battery_value: About every {} seconds, when you move
loc_change_time_body: The new time counts from now.
loc_case_none: No location is available here. It appears only if this person chose to share with you and is still sharing. A report doesn't change that.
loc_case_note: From their own sharing, not a confirmed current location.

loc_change_people_body.one: 1 person will be able to see your location. Anyone else stops seeing it now.
loc_change_people_body.other: {} people will be able to see your location. Anyone else stops seeing it now.

re_legend_meeting: Family or community spot, not verified (hollow square)
re_empty_body: Family appear here when they share with you. Help points appear once staff have added them.
re_nudge_body: Your family will get a notification asking them to check this map. It won't say where anyone is.
re_safe_title: Someone here needs staff to help
re_safe_1: Ask them to stay where they are, or with staff. Don't ask them to walk to you.
re_safe_2: Meet at a verified help point, where staff can stay with them.
re_safe_3: Staff will check who you are in person before any handover.
re_safe_4: A QR scan or a location match doesn't prove who anyone is.
re_safe_self_title: Go to staff, not across the crowd
re_safe_self_1: Find the nearest help desk or someone in uniform.
re_safe_self_2: Stay with staff until your family comes.
re_safe_self_3: Don't walk off on your own to find your family. Don't go with someone you don't know.
re_use_safe_point: This person needs a verified, staffed help point.
re_caution_stay_put: Ask them to stay where they are and go to them, or meet at a help point. Don't ask them to walk to you.
re_points_none_body: Help points appear here once staff have checked and added them. Until then, ask any staff member or volunteer nearby.
re_points_saved: Saved on {}. This may be out of date.
re_safe_only_note: Only verified, staffed places are shown here.
re_straight_note: Distances here are in a straight line, not walking distance.
re_community_note: Suggested by a family. It may not be staffed, and nobody has confirmed it.
re_family_note: A place your family chose. It isn't staffed.
re_share_body: Your family will be notified in the app. No public link is created.
re_choose_body: {} will be the meeting point for this case. Your family and staff will be told.
re_add_hint: Tap the map to place it. Only your family will see it.
re_add_need_both: Add a name and tap the map.
re_route_unavailable: A route preview isn't available right now. Google Maps can still give you directions.
re_route_no_gps: We can't read your location, so there's no route from here.
re_route_offline: No connection, so a route can't be worked out.
re_route_old: Route from {}. It can't be refreshed and may no longer be right.
re_stage_reported_means: Choose a safe place to meet.
re_stage_point_chosen_means: Head there, and stay in touch with staff.
re_stage_at_point_means: Being there isn't confirmation. Wait for staff to check.
re_stage_verifying_means: Staff are checking identities in person.
re_stage_closed_means: This case is no longer open.
re_recommended: Suggested places, from those staff have verified:
re_recommended_safe: The safest places for this person, staffed first:
re_arrived_body: This doesn't confirm anyone's identity or close the case.
re_person_there: Staff say the person has arrived
re_no_proximity: Being close on the map proves nothing. A reunion is only recorded after an in-person check.
sos_hold_semantics: Send SOS. Starts a 5 second countdown you can cancel.
sos_use_countdown: Can't hold? Use a 5 second countdown
sos_what_happens: We notify your family straight away. If your location is allowed, your current position is sent once to them and to authorized responders. It doesn't track you.
sos_no_dispatch: Kumbh Path does not call the police or an ambulance. If you need them now, call directly.
sos_who_unknown: We can't check this right now.
sos_who_nobody: Nobody in a family yet, so no relative will be told.
sos_loc_allowed: Allowed. It's sent once when you press SOS.
sos_loc_approx: Approximate only. Responders will see a rough area.
sos_loc_off: Location is off. You can still send an SOS, and describe where you are.
sos_loc_blocked: Location is blocked. You can still send an SOS, and describe where you are.
sos_loc_denied: Not allowed yet. You can still send an SOS without it.
sos_failed_body: Your family has not been told. If you need help now, call directly.
sos_failed_saved: Saved on this phone as not sent. It will only go if you choose to send it.
sos_saved_send_body: This was written {}. It will go out now as a current SOS, and your family will be alerted.
sos_saved_discard_body: It was never sent, and it will be removed from this phone.
sos_call_body: This is a normal phone call from your phone. It is separate from a Kumbh Path SOS.
sos_call_person_body: This uses a normal phone call. The number isn't shown, and the call attempt is recorded.
sos_stale: We can't refresh this right now, so it may be out of date.
sos_stage_saved: Your SOS is saved on our server
sos_stage_sent: Notification sent to {} of {} family members
sos_stage_family_ack: Seen and acknowledged by {} of {} family members
sos_stage_no_responder: No responder has acknowledged this yet
sos_by_person: By the person who sent it
sos_status_SUBMITTED_means: Saved. No family notification has been accepted for delivery yet.
sos_status_FAMILY_NOTIFIED_means: Sent to the notification service. That doesn't mean anyone has seen it.
sos_status_ACKNOWLEDGED_means: An authorized responder has seen this.
sos_status_ASSISTANCE_COORDINATED_means: A responder has recorded how help is being arranged.
sos_status_RESOLVED_means: A responder has recorded this as resolved.
sos_status_CANCELLED_means: Cancelled by the person who sent it.
sos_acknowledge_note: This tells them you've seen it. You aren't a responder, and it doesn't change the emergency's status.
sos_acknowledged_done: They'll see that you've seen it
sos_cancel_hint: For example, pressed by mistake or I'm safe now
sos_cancelled: SOS cancelled. Your family has been told.
sos_assist_none: Verified assistance points aren't available yet
sos_assist_failed: This can't be loaded right now
sos_assist_none_body: Places appear here once staff have checked them. Ask any staff member or volunteer nearby, or call directly.
note_empty_body: Messages meant for you will appear here.
note_stale: We can't refresh this right now, so it may be out of date.
note_delivery_pending: Still trying to send this to your phone
note_delivery_no_device: Not pushed to a phone: none is registered
note_delivery_failed: Couldn't be pushed to your phone
note_emergency_body: Always on, so a family emergency always reaches you.
note_safety_off_body: You'd stop getting pushes about serious incidents and Lost & Found cases. They'd still appear in Notifications, and emergency SOS alerts stay on.
set_notif_family_location_desc: When someone starts or stops sharing with you
set_notif_reunification_desc: Family messages about where to meet
ops_sign_in_link: Volunteer or staff? Sign in here
ops_sign_in_intro: For accounts approved by an administrator.
ops_setup_intro: Use the one-time code your administrator gave you.
ops_first_time: First time? Use your one-time code
ops_password_weak: Choose a longer, less common password.
ops_status_pending_body: An administrator needs to activate your account before you can start.
ops_availability_note: Off duty or unavailable means no new cases. It doesn't change what you can access.
ops_sos_none: No SOS alerts in your area
ops_team_empty: No active volunteers in your zones
ops_no_cases_body: New work appears here and in your notifications.
ops_no_zones_body: Ask your administrator to assign you a zone.
ops_no_points: No verified help points here yet.
ops_role_managed: Only an administrator can change your role or zones.
ops_vulnerable_note: A child or vulnerable person. Their exact position isn't shown here. Keep them with staff, and don't hand them to anyone without staff checking.
ops_progress_note: This updates your task only. It doesn't mark anyone as found or reunited.
ops_escalate_hint: Why does this need a coordinator?
ops_unassign_body: The volunteer will lose access to this case.
ops_responder_note: These are records in Kumbh Path. They don't contact police or an ambulance.
ops_sos_ack_body: The person and their family will see that a responder has it.
ops_sos_update_hint: The person and family will see this
lf_ai_note: Optional drafts to help you read this report. The original above doesn't change, and a person decides everything.
lf_ai_unavailable: AI help is unavailable right now. You can carry on without it.
lf_ai_reviewed: AI translated, checked by a person
lf_ai_uncertain: May be incomplete. Check the original.
lf_ai_stale: The report has changed since this was made.
lf_ai_details_generated: AI generated. Not used for matching until you accept it.
lf_ai_details_accepted: AI generated, accepted by a person.
lf_match_confidence_high: Confidence: higher. Still not proof of identity.
lf_match_confidence_medium: Confidence: medium. Not proof of identity.
lf_match_confidence_low: Confidence: low. Not proof of identity.
lf_match_used_ai: Includes details a person accepted from AI extraction.
